profile.name: TopMode 主动稳频二极管激光器
profile.description: TOPTICA 的 TopMode 是一款带主动稳定功能的二极管激光器。该设备可通过串口控制激光使能、查询控制器与各控制板状态，并读取激光波长、强度、模式跳变及校正相关信息，适用于需要稳定窄线宽激光输出的实验场景。
profile.description_en: The TOPTICA TopMode is an actively stabilized diode laser. It can be controlled over a serial interface to enable laser emission, query controller and board health, and read wavelength, intensity, mode-hop, and correction-related information for experiments requiring stable narrow-linewidth laser output.

registry.name: Communicates with a `Toptica Topmode`_ instrument
registry.description: TOP Mode是一款表征设备，主要功能包括使能、启动、执行、状态查询、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, correction等操作。
